text.description_html:
First Impressions AP-YRK01ACBAL, Modern Acrylic Appliance Handle

This Modern Acrylic Appliance Handle is handmade in the USA by the master craftsmen at First Impressions from the finest clear acrylic available. The acrylic is manufactured with UV inhibitors to prevent yellowing and fading. The retro-modern design of this space age acrylic appliance handle is really stunning; our pictures do not do them justice. The mounts are finished in brushed aluminum.

Specifications for the First Impressions AP-YRK01ACBAL Modern Refrigerator Handles:

  • Handle Material: Clear Acrylic
  • Bracket Material: Aluminum
  • Bracket Finish: Brushed Aluminum
  • Pull Mounting: Standard 3/4" Thick Appliance Panel

Available in 3 Sizes:

    YRK01018ACBAL:
    • Total Length: 12"
    • Center to Center Mount: 8"
    • Width: 1"
    • Thickness: 5/8"
    • Clearance: 1-1/2"
    • Total Projection: 2-1/8"

    YRK01018ACBAL:
    • Total Length: 18"
    • Center to Center Mount: 12"
    • Width: 1"
    • Thickness: 5/8"
    • Clearance: 1-1/2"
    • Total Projection: 2-1/8"

    YRK01024ACBAL:
    • Total Length: 24"
    • Center to Center Mount: 18"
    • Width: 1"
    • Thickness: 5/8"
    • Clearance: 1-1/2"
    • Total Projection: 2-1/8"

Note: This First Impressions acrylic appliance pull is handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Sold Individually
